confidence_notes: Washington city-level prices were updated 15 October 2026. The cocktail estimate is from a smaller sample updated 23 July; wine is estimated from the local draft-beer price. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates and can vary substantially by date.
comparable_city_reasoning: No separate comparable city used; food and drink are based on Washington, D.C. city-level prices, while accommodation reflects the city's high-cost U.S. capital market.
